about: Skills: capabilities a company can bring to bear. A skill is granted by a background, a class or an equipped item; who grants it is declared on the granting entry, never here.

woodcraft.name: Woodcraft
woodcraft.description: Reading animals and wild country: tracks, warning signs, a safe approach.

source.notes: Orsino rolls d20 + pickLockBonus; Kyr lockwork succeeds where a lock allows it.
Orsino's disarm check is a roll; Kyr trapwork is deterministic.

wayfinding.name: Wayfinding
wayfinding.description: Knowing a region's roads before walking them.

digging.name: Digging
digging.description: Moving earth and stone quickly and safely.

climbing.name: Climbing
climbing.description: Using climbing routes with the right equipment.

reading_the_dead.name: Reading the dead
reading_the_dead.description: Seeing the names and markings that keepers of the dead wrote in consecrated light.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.description: Moving unseen and unheard: slipping past a watcher, a guardian or a beast without a fight.

lore.name: Lore
lore.description: Old histories, scripts and the workings of magic: reading what others only see.

rites.name: Rites of the dead
rites.description: The prayers and forms that give the dead rest; what keeps the unquiet in their graves.

brawn.name: Brawn
brawn.description: Strength used with judgement: lifting a fallen weight clear, wrenching a lock off its hasp, holding a door.

light.name: Light
light.description: Carrying a light that shows the way in unlit places.

sunlight.name: Sunlight
sunlight.description: Carrying daylight itself: it shows the way where other light dies, and things of the dark cannot bear it.
